slug: 2025-11-17 Angola begins issuance of ID cards to newborns

AGO.note: No exchange of records between the civil register and the ID system stated.

facts.fact: Biometric Update says Angola is beginning to issue national ID cards to newborns at maternity wards, starting in Mbanza Kongo municipality of Zaire province, then its 10 other municipalities.
facts.system: newborn national ID issuance (Born with a birth certificate)

AGO.note: No public register keyed on the ID number stated.

facts.fact: Biometric Update says Angola is issuing national ID cards, now to newborns in Zaire province; it hopes to model a digital ID on Aadhaar.

systems.owner: Ministry of Justice and Human Rights
